owner_requirements: gb_feedback_1710/1730: publish the v0.0.22 miss (done in #32), diagnose the v0.0.13 hard-gate miss (36/48) and the blocked-game monotonicity before claiming any level-up, then v0.0.23 with ONE lever on a fresh branch; tag only on a prereg pass; nice 19, host CPU <= 85%
question: Does paying the bonus only for knockdowns the ending attributes (not falls left unresolved by body contact) remove v0.0.22's blocked games, so that the v0.0.13 hard gate and the monotonicity validity floors pass while the primary still beats frozen v0.0.19?
lever: ONE change from the v0.0.22 recipe: the fitness bonus. v0.0.22: knocked_down. v0.0.23: motor_gate.clean_knocked_down = knocked_down AND the opponent's first loss is attributed 'knockdown' by endings.BoutMonitor (not 'unresolved' after body-on-body contact in the 0.5 s lookback). Initialisation (v0.0.19 final_params), training opponent (frozen v0.0.19), model, ES settings, reset and ending v2 unchanged.
why_this_lever: cycle-0032/0033: v0.0.22 lost 0 of 168 valid games; its hard gate (36/48 valid vs v0.0.13) and monotonicity (@16 vs v0.0.19 38/48 valid) failed only on blocked games. Replays of blocked hard-gate games (seeds 14002/14003, both seats) show the opponent's fall at ~1355 ticks attributed 'unresolved' because of 5-9 ticks of torso-to-torso contact in the lookback, after the candidate had landed head hits; v0.0.22's bonus paid for those falls.
classification: solo motor fitness against a frozen opponent (no match outcome in the fitness); diagnostic, not an unassisted boxing result
env: grokbot.scenarios.RangeBoxingEnv(separation_m=0.5, horizon_ticks=3000); unchanged jekko env; runs to the horizon (does not stop at the first fall)

training.method: grokbot.motor_gate.train antithetic ES with CRN, run as 16 + 32 iterations on one generator (identical to one 48-iteration call) so the @16 checkpoint is kept

gate.stance_pass: candidate stands (no persistent non-foot floor support) for the full 3000 ticks
gate.reach_pass: candidate lands >= 1 strike tick (approach and referee active speed >= 0.5 m/s on a strike target)
gate.also_reported: scoring_reach_rate (share of trials with >= 1 head/torso hit); not part of the primary gate
gate.note: motor gate vs gen4, reported (not gating)

primary.name: vs frozen v0.0.19 on NEW seeds 16000-16023 (48 games), checked in order

head_to_head.env: grokbot.reference_env.ReferenceEndingEnv(RangeBoxingEnv(separation_m=0.5, horizon_ticks=3000), anti_stalling=True) via grokbot.selfplay.play_game (ending v2, unchanged)
head_to_head.candidate: the trained v0.0.23 GroupPDPolicy, eval noise 0.05
head_to_head.opponent: frozen v0.0.19: kind group_pd, v0.0.19 final_params, eval noise 0.05
head_to_head.sides: each seed with the candidate in corner A and in corner B (48 games)
head_to_head.valid: grokbot.selfplay.valid_result; every game stays in the denominator
head_to_head.elo: Elo = 400*log10(p/(1-p)) with p = (1+mean)/2 clipped to [0.5/n, 1-0.5/n]; Elo lower bound from p_low = (1+lower95)/2 (-inf if p_low <= 0); win rate with a Wilson 95% interval (descriptive)

order: 1. VALIDITY: valid games (selfplay.valid_result) >= 40/48, else verdict VALIDITY_FAILED (fail loud: non-zero exit, later criteria not evaluated)
2. DECISIVENESS: decisive games (valid wins + valid losses, i.e. not draws) >= 24/48, else verdict DECISIVE_FAILED (fail loud)
3. (b) Hoeffding lower95 > 0 and (c) >= half of the candidate's valid wins with >= 1 candidate head/torso hit; else CRITERION_NOT_MET; both pass -> PRIMARY_PASSED

hard_gate_v0013.opponent: frozen v0.0.13 (punch, punch_params(gen4, onset=-3, duration=0, amplitude=2)), eval noise 0.05

monotonicity.pass: for each: valid >= 40/48 first, then Wilson 95% lower bound of the more-trained side's win rate over valid games > 0.55 (same rule as the v0.0.21 addendum)

level_up: tag v0.0.23 iff primary verdict PRIMARY_PASSED AND hard_gate_v0013 passes AND both monotonicity matchups pass

secondary_reported_not_gating.baseline: v0.0.19 self-mirror on the primary seeds
secondary_reported_not_gating.vs_v0016: candidate vs frozen v0.0.16 on seeds 17000-17023
secondary_reported_not_gating.motor_gate: candidate and v0.0.19 (re-run, checked per trial against its committed summary) vs gen4
secondary_reported_not_gating.training: per-iteration stand time, scoring_share, knockdown_share, clean_knockdown_share
secondary_reported_not_gating.reporting: every head-to-head split by the stronger side's seat with wins / losses / draws / no-contests / blocked / engine faults counted separately
secondary_reported_not_gating.blocked_diagnosis: for every blocked game in the primary, hard gate and monotonicity: count; the per-seat split shows them separately

red_team_notes: the attribution rule is strict: ANY non-glove body contact in the 500-tick lookback leaves a fall unresolved; a clean knockdown therefore needs the candidate to keep its body off the opponent for 0.5 s before the fall
v0.0.13 falls on its own at ~1.35 s; an attributed knockdown only needs a strike in the lookback, so wins vs v0.0.13 can still be partly the opponent's own instability (as in cycle 0023)
no game has been played on seeds 16000-18023; smoke tests use seeds >= 99970
pre_declared_readings: LEVEL_UP: tag v0.0.23; next preregister a self-play league seeded from it
hard gate or monotonicity still fails on blocked games: clean knockdowns were not learned; next lever: contact-avoidance (separation) shaping
VALIDITY_FAILED / DECISIVE_FAILED on the primary: the stricter bonus was too sparse; report clean_knockdown_share
